newsitem.title: USA: Bruno's to sell 42 South Carolina, Georgia stores.
newsitem.headline: Bruno's to sell 42 South Carolina, Georgia stores.

text.p: Bruno's Inc. said Tuesday it plans to sell 42 stores in Georgia and South Carolina in an effort to reduce costs and make the chain more efficient.
The company said it also will seek a buyer for its Vidalia, Ga., distribution centre, which serves those stores.
The stores operate under the Piggly Wiggly and FoodMax trade names.

"The stores that we have decided to divest either cannot be efficiently served from the Birmingham distribution centre, or are not located in markets that fall within our strategic growth plans," Senior Vice President David Clark said.
"This divestiture will allow us to better focus our capital spending on building market share in those areas where Bruno's has greater upside potential," he said.
Bruno's Vidalia distribution operation serves 71 stores in Georgia and South Carolina.
Bruno's is a regional food retailer, operating in Alabama, Mississippi, Georgia, Florida, South Carolina and Tennessee.
